body: TL;DR WhatsApp is working on an iMessage-style button to ask someone to share their location. Tapping “Request location” sends a dedicated chat card, potentially saving you from having to explain where to find the sharing options. We manually enabled the feature, but couldn’t verify the recipient’s response flow, and there’s no confirmed release timeline.
